verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, a hardware processor. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers and calls their tools is a software or agent capability, so this story is a category error for a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the M5 itself ships MCP client functionality; the Foundation Models tool-passing mention describes a separate software framework, not MCP support in this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
